analysis.hook_text: The problem isn't the model. It's the missing layer.

evidence: Every team using AI keeps paying the same hidden tax.

creator_profiles.platform_fit: Direct-response business short form built around blunt hooks, one big problem, and a tactical payoff.
voice_traits: Start with the claim, not the setup
Keep one core idea per clip
Translate insight into a concrete business consequence
End with a sharp takeaway instead of a soft fade-out
hook_patterns: You're not getting [result] because of [hidden reason].
The problem isn't [obvious thing]. It's [deeper thing].
If I had to do [goal] again, I'd do this first.
script_rules: Front-load the problem in the first sentence
Use contrast words like but, instead, or actually to create tension
Name the hidden tax or cost of doing nothing
Land on mechanism plus payoff, not vague motivation
avoid: Abstract inspiration without an operational point
More than one major claim in 30 seconds

creator_profiles.platform_fit: Founder-led Reels/TikToks that explain a market problem quickly, then reframe the product as infrastructure.
voice_traits: Lead with an observed pain the audience already feels
Compress the explanation into a single memorable line
Use company-level stakes, not only personal productivity
Favor short spoken lines with clean caption breaks
hook_patterns: If your team uses AI every day, you're paying for this mistake already.
Everyone talks about smarter models. That's not the hard part.
This is the hidden tax behind [workflow].
Most teams think they need another tool. They need a missing layer.
script_rules: Open on a felt pain or false belief
Introduce the product as the missing layer
Explain memory, governance, or compounding quality in plain English
avoid: Trying to cram every feature into one clip

brief_claims.problem: Teams keep re-explaining the same context, re-litigating the same decisions, and re-debugging the same failures because the assistant never truly becomes part of the organization.
brief_claims.solution: MTRX is the intelligent layer that sits between you or your team and the AI coding assistants you already use, so those assistants can remember the right things, stay inside your org's rules and limits, and learn from what actually happened in your projects.
brief_claims.mechanism: MATRX surfaces that context at the right moment so the assistant's answers fit the real situation better without anyone re-pasting everything every time.
brief_claims.payoff: MTRX turns AI coding assistants into a managed company capability: governed, measurable, and grounded in what your teams actually build.
brief_claims.positioning: MTRX turns AI coding assistants into a managed company capability: governed, measurable, and grounded in what your teams actually build.
